name: Incoming referral completeness check
summary: When a referral arrives, the coordinator gets one checklist: what the referring office sent, held against the practice's own referral checklist, what is missing or needs a new copy, and a draft request for exactly those items. A clinician sets urgency; nothing is sent until the coordinator approves it.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of healthcare work: its example of finding what is missing from an incoming referral, with the reader, the trigger, the inputs, the output and the split between the coordinator, who confirms readiness, and the clinician, who sets urgency and clinical requirements.
